verdict.rationale: gstack publishes an agent-oriented artifact, agents-digest/gstack-AGENTS.md, described as gstack's behavioral rules 'compressed for agent hosts without a full skill install', so an agent can be pointed at it. It is a rules digest rather than agent-readable documentation of the product, and there is no llms.txt; a probe for a .md docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, agent-oriented reference docs covering the product itself (beyond the behavioral-rules digest), and independent corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Behavioral rules from gstack (https://github.com/garrytan/gstack), compressed for agent hosts without a full skill install.
